newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips Q1 semiconductor result slips.
newsitem.headline: Philips Q1 semiconductor result slips.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Wednesday severe price erosion of colour monitor tubes and price pressure in semiconductors depressed operating income at the components and semiconductors sector.
Operating income at the unit slipped to 429 million guilders in the first quarter of 1997, from 496 million in the year-ago period, Philips said.
Sales in the sector stagnated at 3.29 billion guilders, virtually unchanged from the first quarter in 1996, it said.
It said lower sales of semiconductors had offset the three percent higher sales achieved in components.
"However, this reflects an upward trend in performance compared with the fourth quarter of 1996," Philips said.
The semiconductors division saw average price erosion of eight percent in 1996, the company said in February.
